source: this or that. ASMR obby tower with satisfying music and sounds from the ASMR and for the This or That options the players have to choose which one is the most satisfying on with calming satisfying music in the background of the game and there is a chat in the left corner of the screen and it's also a public game and at the bottom there is a big screen playing ASMR videos and at the end of the Tower obby there is a cool playground and cool items and a portle to restart the game at the top of the Tower as well as the big screen that play ASMR videos and the obby is needos and satisfying objects that make the ASMR noise of the item

answers.ask: How tall should the tower be, and how many stages?
answers.answer: Make it a small, clearly climbable tower with 10 stages, leading up to the playground and restart portal at the top.

answers.ask: How many this-or-that choice points, and does the choice change the route or just get recorded?
answers.answer: Use one this-or-that choice point per stage, with two short routes based on the selected satisfying ASMR object; both routes rejoin before the next stage.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] scale — Q: How tall should the tower be, and how many stages? A: Make it a small, clearly climbable tower with 10 stages, leading up to the playground and restart portal at the top.
- [author] free — Q: How many this-or-that choice points, and does the choice change the route or just get recorded? A: Use one this-or-that choice point per stage, with two short routes based on the selected satisfying ASMR object; both routes rejoin before the next stage.
- [agent_inferred] obstacle_term — Q: What does “needos” mean in the obstacle description? A: Treat it narrowly as simple needle-like obstacles alongside satisfying object props.
- [agent_inferred] failure_recovery — Q: Does the small tower use intermediate checkpoints? A: Use no intermediate checkpoints; falling returns the player to the base, while the top portal provides a voluntary restart.

## Enriched image prompt
Create a small, clearly climbable 10-stage ASMR obby tower. At every stage, split the path into exactly two short routes themed around different satisfying objects, then rejoin both routes before the next stage. Use simple needle-like obstacles and tactile object props while keeping all jumps and branches physically legal. Place a large physical video screen at the bottom and a second large screen at the top. Finish with a cool playground and item display area on the tower summit, plus a visible restart portal returning to the base. Use a calm, satisfying visual atmosphere; music, object sounds, chat, and video playback are mechanics rather than static geometry.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Obby & Platformer, with Party & Casual secondary because each stage asks public players to make a this-or-that choice.

## Shape and preset
Use `course-tower`, Path (Tower / Spiral Ascent), because 10 stages stack vertically. Match the Tower Obby preset, retaining its tower, sequential course, and summit reward while replacing timed and climbing obstacles with paired ASMR choice routes.

## Config requirements
Use `path-track` for the ordered 10-stage ascent. Use `obstacle-jump` for simple jump geometry and needle-like obstacles. Use `winner-zone` for the summit playground and cool item area. Use `teleporter-link` for the visible top-to-base restart portal, choosing its same-map fast-travel route rather than `P4`. Use `landmark-focal`, reached from Adventure, for exactly two large video screens, one at the base and one at the summit.

## Layout requirements
Place 20 free-text TriggerZones, two at each of the 10 stage branch entrances, so each selected satisfying-object route can be recorded and play its assigned sound. Place `winner-zone` as one WinnerZone covering the summit playground and item area. Place `teleporter-link` as one paired Teleporter connection from the summit restart portal to the base start. Place one free-text SpawnZone at the base; there are no intermediate checkpoints.

## Layout components
The tower has one base, exactly 10 stacked stages, and one summit. Each stage contains a two-way short branch around distinct satisfying-object props, with both routes rejoining before ascent continues. Two large screens sit at bottom and top. The summit contains a playground, cool item displays, and restart portal. Open tower edges form the fall boundary. Frame the complete vertical route and both endpoint screens in one view.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: every branch must rejoin correctly and all jumps must be legal before ASMR object dressing, while `authored_plan` is not supported for an obby tower.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Use medium scale, corresponding to Block, because all 10 stages, branch choices, props, and summit features must remain legible. The theme is calming, colorful ASMR with satisfying tactile objects and large video displays. Use `P6` for valid course construction and `P2` because the stacked tower stages overhang one another.

Simple, physically-legal jump geometry plus simple needle-like obstacles alongside satisfying tactile object props.
A summit payoff area: a cool playground plus an item display area on the tower top.
A visible restart portal at the summit that returns to the base start (same-map fast travel).
